row: Sunrise Horse Rescue - http://www.sunrisehorserescue.org/ - is a non-profit horse rescue and sanctuary located in Napa County, California. We are dedicated to saving horses and providing them with forever homes. Children and adults in the community gain life-enhancing skills by assisting in the rehabilitation of these horses and providing them with the loving attention they so deserve.
